title: Potion of Flying
summary: Drink to gain Flight for 10 turns.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action, single use. Grants Flight for 10 turns.
fields.Fly: Move to a point up to 60 ft away. Uses movement at half the normal cost.
fields.Alchemy: Extract three Eagle Feathers into Sublimate of Eagle Feathers and add any Essence.
fields.Acquisition: Eligible merchants can stock it, usually when the player character is level 9 or higher.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
